adapter.configure_command:
./configure --libbpf_force off && printf "TC_CONFIG_ATM := n
TC_CONFIG_XT := n
TC_CONFIG_NO_XT := y
HAVE_BERKELEY_DB := n
HAVE_CAP := n
HAVE_MNL := n
HAVE_ELF := n
HAVE_RPC := n
HAVE_SELINUX := n
" >> config.mk
adapter.package_command: make DESTDIR="$pkgdir" PREFIX=/usr LIBDIR=/usr/lib SBINDIR=/usr/bin CONFDIR=/etc/iproute2 DOCDIR=/usr/share/doc/iproute2 MANDIR=/usr/share/man ARPDDIR=/var/lib/arpd install
adapter.review_reason: Build pristine iproute2 with upstream configure and Makefiles. Optional libmnl, libbpf, ELF, capabilities, iptables, RPC, Berkeley DB and SELinux integrations are explicitly disabled until packaged independently. The upstream testsuite-only generator unconditionally links libmnl, so the no-libmnl profile validates the built ip, tc and ss executables directly.
